My father taught me to farm this land, and last season I put one bag of NPK on this plot and the maize grew better than where I put nothing. I will do the same this year, and I will also spread cattle manure because it costs me nothing but my own labor. I am planting the seed I kept from my best cobs last harvest; I will not waste cash on new seed when I do not know if it will grow well here. My wife and I will do all the work ourselves — clearing, planting, weeding twice, and harvesting — so I will not hire anyone, and I will not buy chemicals or try to irrigate because we only have the rains God sends.
